note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: Soluna Project Dorothy campus (Dorothy 1 and Dorothy 2, 98 MW energized; Dorothy 3 planned on 397 adjoining acres), behind the meter at the Briscoe Wind Farm near Silverton, Briscoe County, Texas
entries.reason: Status is ready and in window: Soluna's dated release of 14 September 2026 (capture soluna-dorothy-ercot-batch-zero-20260914.html) says Dorothy 1 and Dorothy 2 account for 98 MW of energized capacity on the 100 MW Project Dorothy campus built behind the meter at the 150 MW Briscoe Wind Farm, which Soluna bought in April 2026; its 24 August release (soluna-dorothy-3-land-purchase-20260824.html) says the 397 acres bought for Dorothy 3 adjoin Dorothy 1 and 2 with the wind farm's substation directly across. Locator still missing: the TxGIO parcel layer's query operation now returns 'Requested operation is not supported' (identify only), and an identify sweep across the wind farm's turbine extent (USGS USWTDB, 81 'Briscoe' turbines, lon -101.34 to -101.27, lat 34.32 to 34.42; capture txgio-identify-briscoe-windfarm-area.json, May 2026 roll) shows no Soluna, Dorothy or Briscoe Wind owner and no parcel with data-centre-scale improvements; Soluna publishes no address and TDLR TABS has no Soluna Dorothy registration (tabs-pn-soluna.json, tabs-project-dorothy.json). The parcel sweep returns names of private landowners, which are not copied.
entries.reopen_condition: A current Briscoe County appraisal roll, plat, tax-abatement or reinvestment-zone description, TDLR or TCEQ record, or other official record placing a Soluna-owned Dorothy parcel or the Dorothy address; then admit the Dorothy 1-2 campus as operational (2026-09-14) while within 85 days (until 2026-12-08), or Dorothy 3 as announced from the 21 October 2026 Applied Digital joint-venture release (until 2027-01-14).

entries.candidate: AIB Data Centers CLT1 data center campus (Nebius 50 MW critical IT agreement; reportedly South Carolina)
entries.reason: AIB Data Centers (NYSE American: AIB, formerly BlockchAIn Digital Infrastructure) announced on 30 September 2026 a binding 12-year agreement with Nebius for 50 MW of critical IT capacity at its existing CLT-01 facility in the south-eastern United States with a 65 MW electric service agreement, and a 7 October CEO letter repeats it (seen through web search results only). AIB's releases do not name the site; trade press places CLT1 in South Carolina from an investor presentation. The primary copies are on sec.gov and globenewswire.com, both of which answered robots.txt with HTTP 403 to this credential-free client, so nothing was captured and no address or parcel is known.
entries.reopen_condition: An accessible AIB filing or presentation (for example an Internet Archive copy of the 8-K exhibits) or a county record naming the CLT1 address or parcel; then admit as announced (2026-09-30) while within 85 days (until 2026-12-24).

entries.candidate: Applied Digital Jamestown APLD GPU-01 processing building (Auditor's Lot 17-2C, SE1/4 Section 17, T141N R63W, Stutsman County, North Dakota)
entries.reason: The GPU-01 lot (2.72 acres, APLD GPU-01 LLC, one commercial structure in the 2025 tax roll) is part of the Jamestown site this fragment adds, but only one project can be added to a new site in one update, and no dated in-window statement of the GPU building's own status was found (the FY2026 10-K says only that GPU-01's AI cloud services are serviced at the Jamestown hosting facility).
entries.reopen_condition: After the Jamestown site is published, a dated in-window Applied Digital or ChronoScale statement of the GPU-01 building's operation or works; add it as a project reusing the Jamestown campus locator exactly.

entries.candidate: Bitdeer Massillon (fire-damaged buildings rebuild), Clarington and Wenatchee (existing Atlas records): August and September 2026 production and operations updates
entries.reason: Bitdeer's monthly updates (6-K exhibits) may refresh these records (the Massillon rebuild was targeted for energization by the end of September 2026, a forecast), but ir.bitdeer.com, bitdeer.gcs-web.com, www.globenewswire.com and www.sec.gov all answered robots.txt with HTTP 403 to this client and the Internet Archive has no copy of the September 2026 exhibit or the IR news index (wb-avail-bitdeer-sep2026.json, wb-avail-bitdeer-news-20261020.json). bitdeer.com's own news sitemap carries no production updates.
entries.reopen_condition: An accessible archived or Bitdeer-hosted copy of the September or October 2026 update with a dated statement of completion, energization or works at Massillon, Clarington or Wenatchee.

entries.candidate: Core Scientific Muskogee campus expansion after the Polaris DS acquisition (existing record imported:semiconductor-atlas:core-scientific-muskogee)
